I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer this season, so I will use the poultry manure I have saved to strengthen the soil on this small plot. I will plant local cassava stem cuttings that I kept from last year's harvest, and my family will clear the weeds by hand when the rains come. Since the plot is only 0.06 hectares, my children and I can manage all the work ourselves without hiring outside help.
